description: A STAC/Portolan catalog of Planet Labs PBC Crisis Response Program satellite imagery for major disaster events (earthquakes, floods, storms, wildfires). Each event is a sub-catalog with pre- and post-event high-resolution cloud-optimized GeoTIFFs (visual, pansharpened analytic, usable-data masks) and STAC-GeoParquet item indexes.
readme: ## README.md # Disaster Data Releases from Planet Labs PBC Imagery from the [Planet Crisis Response Program](https://www.planet.com/disasterdata/) for major disaster events — earthquakes, floods, storms, wildfires and human-made disasters — as a single browsable catalog. Each event is a self-contained sub-catalog with pre- and post-event high-resolution COGs (visual, pansharpened-analytic and usable-data masks), organised by affected location. Imagery © Planet Labs PBC, licensed [CC-BY-NC-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/) (non-commercial). This is a [Portolan](https://portolan-sdi.org) / [STAC](https://stacspec.org) catalog: the umbrella root (`catalog.json`) links to one self-contained sub-catalog per disaster event, and new events are added as new sub-catalogs. - **Browse now:** [open in the Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/catalog.json) - **Root catalog:** [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/catalog.json) - **Agent / LLM guide:** [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/llms.txt) — point Claude Code or another agent at it to explore and query the data - **License:** [CC-BY-NC-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/) (non-commercial) — © Planet Labs PBC - **Contact:** Planet Crisis Response Program — [crisis-response@planet.com](mailto:crisis-response@planet.com) ## Events ### [Planet Crisis Response — Panama Earthquake (2026)](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/panama-earthquake-2026-10-09) Planet imagery of the M7.6 earthquake that struck about 39 km northwest of Tonosí on Panama's Azuero Peninsula on 9 October 2026, with post-event Pelican, PlanetScope and SkySat collects (11–15 October) and a 2026 Q3 basemap baseline. - Root catalog: [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/panama-earthquake-2026-10-09/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/panama-earthquake-2026-10-09/catalog.json) - Browse: [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/panama-earthquake-2026-10-09/catalog.json) · [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/panama-earthquake-2026-10-09) - Agent guide: [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/panama-earthquake-2026-10-09/llms.txt) ### [Planet Crisis Response — Bhote Koshi–Trishuli Outburst Flood, Nepal (2026)](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/nepal-flash-flood-2026-08-26) Planet imagery of the 26 August 2026 outburst flood that swept the Bhote Koshi–Trishuli river corridor across the Nepal–China border, killing at least 160 people and leaving hundreds missing. Preliminary assessment attributes the trigger to an ice and rock avalanche from a glacier in the upper catchment. Coverage runs from Trishuli Bazaar north through Syabrubesi and the Rasuwagadhi border crossing into Gyirong County, Tibet Autonomous Region, with a pre-monsoon baseline for before/after comparison. - Root catalog: [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/nepal-flash-flood-2026-08-26/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/nepal-flash-flood-2026-08-26/catalog.json) - Browse: [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/nepal-flash-flood-2026-08-26/catalog.json) · [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/nepal-flash-flood-2026-08-26) - Agent guide: [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/nepal-flash-flood-2026-08-26/llms.txt) ### [Planet Crisis Response — Colombia Earthquake (2026)](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/colombia-earthquake-2026-08-10) Planet imagery of the M7.4 earthquake that struck western Colombia on 10 August 2026 at 12:34 UTC, with an epicentre 5 km south of San José del Palmar, Chocó (4.844°N, 76.242°W) at 110 km depth. - Root catalog: [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/colombia-earthquake-2026-08-10/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/colombia-earthquake-2026-08-10/catalog.json) - Browse: [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/colombia-earthquake-2026-08-10/catalog.json) · [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/colombia-earthquake-2026-08-10) - Agent guide: [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/colombia-earthquake-2026-08-10/llms.txt) ### [Planet Crisis Response — Gironde/Landes Wildfire, France (2026)](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026) Post-fire Planet SkySat imagery of the Gironde/Landes Atlantic wildfire complex near Bordeaux, southwestern France (the Le Porge → Arès run of the July 2026 fires). - Root catalog: [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026/catalog.json) - Browse: [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026/catalog.json) · [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026) - Agent guide: [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/gironde-wildfire-2026/llms.txt) ### [Planet Crisis Response — Venezuela Earthquake (2026)](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24) Planet Crisis Response Program imagery documenting the 24 June 2026 earthquake that struck Venezuela's coast, causing extensive damage in Caracas, La Guaira, Catia La Mar, Puerto Cabello, Valencia, Ocumare de la Costa and Yumare. - Root catalog: [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/catalog.json) - Browse: [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24/catalog.json) · [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/venezuela-earthquake-2026-06-24) - Root catalog: [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/philippines-earthquake-2026-06-08/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/philippines-earthquake-2026-06-08/catalog.json) - Browse: [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/philippines-earthquake-2026-06-08/catalog.json) · [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/philippines-earthquake-2026-06-08) - Root catalog: [https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025/catalog.json](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025/catalog.json) - Browse: [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025/catalog.json) · [Source Cooperative](https://source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025) - Agent guide: [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/hurricane-melissa-2025/llms.txt) ## Using the catalog **Browse** the whole catalog in the [Portolan browser](https://browser.portolan-sdi.org/#/external/data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/catalog.json), or open `https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/catalog.json` in any STAC browser. **Explore with AI.** Point [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) or another agent at [llms.txt](https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata/llms.txt) (each event has its own too) and ask it to query the data, make maps, or compare pre/post-event imagery. **Query with DuckDB.** Every collection has a STAC-GeoParquet `items.parquet` index of its scenes (id, datetime, geometry, cloud cover, asset hrefs): ```sql INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial; SELECT id, datetime, assets FROM read_parquet( 'https://data.source.coop/planet/disasterdata//post-event/items.parquet' ); ``` **Open a COG.** Asset hrefs are absolute public URLs — stream just the pixels you need with `/vsicurl`, rio-tiler, rasterio or GDAL, no download or API key required. --- *Imagery © Planet Labs PBC — [Crisis Response Program](https://www.planet.com/disasterdata/) (CC BY-NC 4.0). Contact: [crisis-response@planet.com](mailto:crisis-response@planet.com).*
